he 2.5–3.0s cells the two rear ghouls are blocked by the fire-bird and dust, so 'still glaring at her through the claw gaps' can't be confirmed either. At 4.0–5.75s, while they burn, it's also unclear whether the one ghoul that was supposed to look up and stare at her actually does. The spec requires them to face left toward her the whole time. These frames can't confirm that, so I'm marking it fail. The sections where they are burning or dead (3.6s onward, apart from that one ghoul) are exempt.
✗ video.fidelity 不通过：[fidelity·codex] 图2锁定的是长颈与鸟头向右前探、宽大双翼向后掠开的火鸟，橙黄火浪包裹首只食尸鬼形成正面冲击。图1第2行第3–4格（2.50–2.75秒）的火鸟却呈向上竖起的扇形展翼，接在细长火柱前端；第5格（3.00秒）又变成扁长火团，鸟头、长颈与双翼轮廓不再清楚。第6–7格（3.25–3.50秒）再次出现高竖翼形。橙红与亮黄色基本相符，但最强几格的火鸟形状、火浪体量及包裹命中的效果未还原图2。
